violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Reasonable Accommodations or Modifications (26 TAC §744.605(12)(B)(i))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - Reasonable Accommodations or Modifications
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation has not gotten any requested accommodations for the four children that are needing them. Three children were observed during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: The operation has not gotten any requested accommodations for the four children that are needing them. Three children were observed during the inspection.
The operation has a total for four children that need accommodation forms.
A child was observed using a ipad during the entire inspection on Youtube. No accommodations forms were available for review.
The operation has three children enrolled that admission forms note that accommodations are needed. The operation does not have accommodations on file for the three children.
The operation does not have an accommodation plan for a child in care who is enrolled with an identified special need.
The operation has a total for four children that need accommodation forms. One child was observed during the inspection.
